title: Gameplay music videos and trailers
description: One music video or trailer per song, from real gameplay driven by script in engine, captured frame-accurately with Godot Movie Maker and laid over the exact song file with its captions. Derived from the ShammyVerse soundtrack production. The vendor, dry-run and record stages run through tools/game_music_video.py; shot lists are game code written per song. Recorder 0.4.0 adds ambient staging hooks (held shots, beats, lyric keywords), a beat-clock hook and a motion check for dead shots.

optional_ai: Drafting a song's shot list from its captions and the game's settings; a person writes or approves every shot.

godot.title: Godot 4 console executable (Movie Maker)
godot.notes: Movie Maker records at the window size; the tool applies the resolution through a temporary override.cfg.

display.title: Desktop display at least as large as the capture window
display.notes: Recording opens a visible Godot window for the length of the render. Dry runs are headless.

project_folder.title: Godot project folder
project_folder.help: The game's folder that contains project.godot. The recorder base is vendored into addons/gamecore_music_video/.

godot_executable.title: Godot console executable
godot_executable.help: Exact engine build used for capture (Godot_*_console.exe on Windows); recorded in the production record.

recorder_script.title: Game recorder script
recorder_script.help: The game's adapter and shot lists, extending the vendored music_video_recorder.gd.

output_folder.title: Output folder
output_folder.help: In the game's design folder; videos are not stored in GameCore.

songs.title: Song ids
songs.help: One song id per line, matching the recorder script's _produce() cases.

song_audio_folder.title: Runtime song files
song_audio_folder.help: The exact audio the game ships; mixed unnormalized over the capture and hashed in each video record.

spoiler_policy.title: Spoiler policy
spoiler_policy.help: spoiler-light: each song stays in its own setting; no completions, rewards, unlocks or story reveals. Enforced by shot-list review, not by the tool.

hud.title: HUD
hud.help: captions-only hides every CanvasLayer except the caption layer the adapter keeps.

min_shot.title: Shortest shot
min_shot.help: Cuts land on caption starts at least this far apart (recorder MIN_SHOT).

max_shot.title: Shot length without captions
max_shot.help: Uncaptioned stretches are cut about this often (recorder MAX_SHOT).

resolution.title: Capture size
resolution.help: Match the game's aspect so nothing is letterboxed and UI layout does not change.

fps.title: Frame rate
fps.help: Must equal the recorder's FPS constant.

sfx_db.title: Game effects level under the song

preview_mb.title: Sharing preview size
preview_mb.help: 960x600 copy for sharing tools with an upload limit.

stages.title: Check tools and inputs
stages.description: Probe Godot, FFmpeg and Python, confirm the project and song files exist and the output folder is writable.

checks.title: Engine, FFmpeg and song files present

stages.title: Vendor the recorder
stages.description: Copy 3d/godot/music_video/music_video_recorder.gd into the game with a SHA-256 lock; refuse to overwrite local edits.

stages.title: Write adapter and shot lists
stages.description: Game code: adapter methods, per-song fixture and a shot list of short purposeful shots cut on caption starts, following the spoiler policy.

checks.title: Shot lists reviewed against the spoiler policy

stages.title: Dry run headless
stages.description: Run every song headless at the fixed frame rate: completion, shot count, script errors and shots the camera guard could not clear (CHECK).

checks.title: Every song finishes with no script errors
Every CHECK shot looked at and fixed or accepted

stages.title: Record, mix and encode
stages.description: Movie Maker capture at the chosen window size (shared temporary override.cfg), trim to the song start, mix the exact song over game effects, encode MP4, preview and contact sheet.

checks.title: Video length equals song plus tail; preview under the size limit

stages.title: Review and deliver
stages.description: Contact-sheet review, spoiler review and audio audition by a person; results written to the production record.

checks.title: tools/game_music_video.py motion run; dead shots reframed or accepted
Each video watched against the spoiler policy
Song and effects auditioned on speakers and headphones

steps.title: Choose the game
steps.summary: Godot project, engine build, the game's recorder script and the output folder; the recorder is vendored with a lock.

steps.title: Songs and shot lists
steps.summary: Song ids, runtime audio, spoiler policy and HUD; shot lists are written in the game and dry-run headless.

steps.title: Capture and mix
steps.summary: Capture size and frame rate, effects level and preview size; each song renders slower than real time.

steps.title: Review and deliver
steps.summary: Contact sheets, spoiler review and audio audition, recorded in the production record.
